claims.head: Penalties could cost the Wild
claims.call: The Panthers’ power play creates at least their usual 7.9 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Panthers’ power play is near the top of the league, and the Wild’s kill is around the middle of the league. Every trip to the box hurts the Wild more than most.
claims.nums: Florida 8th for power play (7.9 expected goals per 60) · Minnesota 22nd for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Panthers’ power play has a soft target in the Wild’s kill.

check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: The Wild get in close; the Panthers shoot from distance
claims.body: The Wild are one of the league’s best for shots from in close, at the close-range end; the Panthers are near the bottom of the league, at the long-range end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.nums: Shots from in close: Minnesota 5th, Florida 25th
claims.gist: The Wild and the Panthers sit at opposite ends for shots from in close.
claims.call: The Wild take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Panthers.

FLA.head: Nothing to separate these two
FLA.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Florida has home ice. For Florida, the difference could be keeping dangerous shots away.
